links.comparator_used: No-RAG baseline (and unions of graphs, i.e. broader KG retrieval sources)
links.outcome: Accuracy on domain-specific probes (AD/T2DM) across seven instruction-tuned LLMs
links.effect: Scope-matched KG retrieval (notably G2) yielded the most consistent gains; indiscriminate graph unions often introduced distractors that reduced accuracy; larger models frequently matched or exceeded KG-RAG with a No-RAG baseline on Probe 1; smaller/mid-sized models benefited more from well-scoped retrieval. No numeric values reported in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Indiscriminate graph unions introduce distractors that reduce accuracy.
links.quote: Larger models frequently match or exceed KG-RAG with a No-RAG baseline on Probe 1, indicating strong parametric priors, whereas smaller/mid-sized models benefit more from well-scoped retrieval.
